arguments.message: Hi! To re‑enrol your two‑factor after switching phones, go to Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication and tap **Reset**. Then scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and confirm with the fresh six‑digit code. If you can’t reach the settings page, use the recovery code you saved during the original setup to sign in and perform the reset from there. Once you’ve set up the new QR code, the old one becomes invalid and you’ll have access again.
